codeReview.summary: Clean, minimal soundness fix. A sealed ImmutableQuery marker trait is introduced in katla_ecs/src/query/mod.rs with implementations for &T and all-immutable tuples up to arity 8. The trait is sealed via a private sealed::Sealed supertrait, preventing external crates from implementing ImmutableQuery for mutable patterns. query_ref's Q parameter is now bounded on both QueryData + ImmutableQuery, making query_ref::<&mut T>() a compile-time error. query() (with &mut self) remains unrestricted. Two new unit tests verify immutable single and tuple queries work correctly through &World. All 101 ECS tests pass.

summary: The ecs-fix-query-ref-soundness feature correctly closes the query_ref soundness hole identified in VAL-ECS-001 and VAL-ECS-002. The sealed ImmutableQuery marker trait approach is idiomatic Rust — the private Sealed supertrait prevents external crates from implementing ImmutableQuery for mutable query patterns, and the explicit impl list for &T and all-immutable tuples up to arity 8 provides compile-time enforcement. query_ref now requires Q: QueryData + ImmutableQuery, making query_ref::<&mut T>() a compile error. The existing call sites (katla_app scene serialization and editor) use immutable patterns and are unaffected. Two new unit tests verify correctness. All 101 ECS tests pass. No blocking issues found.
